CAF.note: No broadband plan or its targets are mentioned.

facts.fact: Sunvi Media says the Central African Republic's network rests largely on the 935 km Central African Backbone fibre linking it to neighbouring countries, and that connection through the coastal countries' terrestrial networks has raised speeds.

CAF.note: Only one route is stated; an eastward route via South Sudan is under study with no path or terms set.
The 30 per cent for 2026 and 15.5 per cent for early 2025 are hedged ('aurait') and unattributed, so not a survey or ITU figure.

facts.fact: Sunvi Media says the 935 km Central African Backbone fibre provides the link with neighbouring countries and that vandalism in March 2026 partly paralysed national telecoms services.

CAF.note: The eastward link with South Sudan is under study, with route and terms undefined, so not an agreement.
